# Decisive Finance

> Decision-First Finance for owner-led operating companies, $5M to $50M in revenue. In 14 days, we show an owner their company the way a buyer will, in dollars, guaranteed: at least 3x the fee in owner-accepted value identified, or the owner pays nothing. Typical results run 5x to 10x. We never guarantee a sale price or a multiple.

You can't sell a company on numbers you don't trust yourself. Most owners aren't waiting for the right market. They're waiting for numbers they'd be willing to show. A sale price is a multiple times earnings; we work both numbers: the earnings a buyer multiplies (pricing, mix, margin truth) and the believability, concentration, and owner independence that earn the multiple.

For owners who are not selling, the same numbers are costing them every month. Revenue's up, profit isn't, and the numbers can't say why. The Decision Diagnostic runs the same engine without the buyer's lens.

## Services

- [The Sellable-Numbers Scan](https://decisive.finance/scan): 14 days. See your company the way a buyer will, in dollars. The re-price read (what diligence would knock off the number), the worth read (where value expansion lives), and the first three moves. $10,000 for $5M to $8M revenue; $15,000 for $8M to $25M; $20,000 for $25M to $50M. Guaranteed 3x the fee in owner-accepted value or free.
- [The Decision Diagnostic](https://decisive.finance/diagnostic): 14 days. Names what the money is actually doing, in dollars: which products, customers, or jobs make money, where the recoverable value sits, and what to do first. Same bands and guarantee as the Scan.
- The 90-Day Decision Resolution: installs the decision rhythm, proven on real decisions, in market. $30,000 to $60,000 by revenue band. A Resolution signed within 7 days of the Scan or Diagnostic readout credits that fee in full.
- [The Partnership](https://decisive.finance/partnership): monthly, $7,500 to $12,500 by revenue band. Exit-Value Partnership (12 to 24 months to market, quarterly re-valuation) or Decision Partnership (the Financial Rhythm System as the operating cadence). Fees tied to the value created, never to the deal.

## Fit

For founders and owners of operating companies, $5M to $50M in revenue, especially EOS and Vistage companies, manufacturing, consumer products, professional services, and construction. Not for companies under $5M in revenue, anyone who wants a promised sale price or a buyer found, or anyone shopping for bookkeeping.

Contact: russell@decisive.finance. Booking: one 30-minute fit call at https://calendly.com/russell-decisive/30min.
